name: Heart of the Wandering Star
summary: A gem that grants wishes of a limited kind and lets you travel between worlds.
description: Fell from the sky into a fallow field, and burned there until a farmer built a shrine around it. It is cold as a mountain lake.

stats.effect: The gem has 3 charges. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 charge to cast *Wish* from it, though only to duplicate another spell of 8th level or lower. Alternatively, you can expend 1 charge to cast *Plane Shift* from it. The gem regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1, the gem fades and is lost.
